_comment: (TpaCode, ProductTypeCode, PlanCode) → PlanLevel (Good/Better/Best) + public copy + URL. Ports the legacy PlanSelectorService PLAN_QUALITY_MAPPING + the consumer self-serve PDF mockup notes about per-plan public overrides.
_legacy_source: blinker/app/services/plan_selector_service.rb#PLAN_QUALITY_MAPPING (Wave 21 — extended with StoneEagle v1.31 spec product_type_codes + regulated_rule_behavior + discountable_flag_behavior blocks; Wave 22 — extended with add_on_passthrough block driven by v3.0.4 PDF tasks 1/2/4; Wave 27 v3.0.8 — promoted plan_overrides → plan_catalog + populated plan_level_defaults HTML/tagline from v3.0.8 PDF + added docuseal_template_id field per plan).
_principle: A unique plan is identified by (TpaCode, ProductTypeCode, PlanCode). The mapping below promotes that triple into a Good/Better/Best level + customer-facing copy. Defaults from this file; org config can override.

product_type_codes._comment: Canonical Product Type Codes from SEFI SCS eRating Integration Guide v1.31 §ProductCollection / §Plan Object. Returned by GetRates and recognized by GenerateContract. Providers may extend with custom codes; canon enumerates the 12 standard codes used to render product-type filter chips in the customer-facing wizard and the admin Integrations products_filter multiselect.

regulated_rule_behavior._comment: Per StoneEagle GetRates spec v1.31 §Rate Object / §Rating Rules. Returned per Rate as `regulated_rule_id` (integer 0/3/5/6). Powers retail-vs-markup editability in the customer-facing wizard. See architecture/13-stoneeagle-integration.md::RegulatedRuleId behavior for the full UX matrix.

0.name: free_markup
0.description: Non-regulated. Seller may add any markup. Retail = NetRate + Markup + (admin markup if present).

3.name: fixed_retail
3.description: Filed-rate plan (e.g., FL VSC, TX GAP). Retail locked at the response RetailRate. Markup field MUST be hidden; rate MUST NOT be editable. Surcharges may still apply.

5.name: capped_markup
5.description: Markup capped between MarkupMin and MarkupMax (inclusive). UI clamps the markup field and warns when outside range.

6.name: finance_capped
6.description: Retail must not exceed FinancedAmount minus a configured %MSRP (new) or %NADA (pre-owned). UI computes the cap from the rate's MaxRetailRate and clamps.

discountable_flag_behavior._comment: Per StoneEagle GetRates spec v1.31 §Plan Object. Returned per Plan as `discountable` (1=allowed, 0=forbidden). Independent of `regulated_rule_id` — both gates compose. The org-level `protection_billing.discount.disabled_in_states` (canon/org-registry.json, see ADR 09) is a third gate that layers on top.

1.description: Retail may be discounted below the response RetailRate, down to (but not below) the NetRate. Subject to org-level discount caps.

0.description: Retail must equal the response RetailRate. No discount permitted regardless of regulated_rule_id.

add_on_passthrough._comment: Canonical add-on names matched (case-insensitive substring) against StoneEagle GetRates response option names. When matched, the add-on cost is added to the plan price WITHOUT markup, and the coverage card surfaces a badge. Read by packages/utils/protection-addons.js + protection-portal RecommendedCoverage/PlanCard. Triggered either ALWAYS (when the plan's add_ons_included[] contains a match — e.g. extended_maintenance) or CONDITIONALLY based on user wizard input (e.g. business_use only triggers when form.use is rideshare/commercial).
add_on_passthrough._principle: match_names is matched case-insensitive-substring against rates.add_ons[].name AND the strings in product.add_ons_included[]. cost_passthrough=true means the add-on's price_delta is added to plan price without markup; cost_passthrough=false means informational badge only (no price change). trigger is documented as a string for human readers; the consuming code in protection-portal hardcodes the trigger predicates because they reference form fields that don't belong in canon.

vehicle_class_rule._comment: Drives the New-vs-Used rate-class branch in StoneEagle GetRates orchestration. A vehicle qualifies as 'new' when BOTH gates pass (INCLUSIVE bounds: age ≤ max_age_years AND miles ≤ max_miles — e.g. a 3-model-year-old vehicle with exactly 36,000 mi IS 'new'); otherwise 'used'. Read by packages/utils/vehicle-class.js#classifyVehicle. When a vehicle qualifies as 'new', the orchestrator fires TWO parallel SE GetRates calls (condition='N' AND condition='U') and merges with each plan tagged rate_class:'new'|'used'; protection-portal then surfaces a 'New' badge + filter chips and prefers new-rate candidates over used within each Good/Better/Best tier. PDF v3.0.5 Task 5 spec'd 60,000 mi but canon's existing TODO threshold (36,000 mi) wins per Wave 23 decision 2026-05-09.

term_semantics._comment: Per-RegulatedRuleId default for how Term Months / Term Miles values returned by SE GetRates should be interpreted in customer-facing display + Coverage Details filter math. 'additive' = the value extends current odometer/age (display: '+24 mo / +50,000 mi'; filter math: compare against currentTerm + plan.term). 'absolute' = the value is the cap from purchase / contract start (display: 'Up to 36 mo / Up to 100,000 mi'; filter math: compare against raw plan.term). Read by packages/integrations/product_admin/stoneeagle.js#normalizeToFixtureShape (surfaces as plan.term_basis) and consumed by protection-portal PlanCard + CoverageDetails. See architecture/12-term-semantics.md for the full UX matrix and why basis is RegulatedRuleId-keyed (filed-rate plans tend to absolute; non-regulated tend to additive).

by_product_type_code._comment: Optional override layer: when set, ProductTypeCode trumps the by_regulated_rule_id default for that plan. Empty by default; populate as fixtures + SE GetRates UAT confirm specific product behaviors.

_example_EWT._note: EWT (Extended Wear & Tear) typically extends factory warranty additively

monthly_membership._comment: Identifies monthly-membership VSC products (M2M / Residual / RAP) in the StoneEagle GetRates response so they get a distinct purchase UX (recurring monthly charge, no down-payment/months-to-pay). See architecture/28-monthly-membership-vsc.md. Read by packages/integrations/product_admin/stoneeagle.js#normalizeToFixtureShape.
monthly_membership._principle: AUTHORITATIVE SIGNAL = the 999999 mileage sentinel. OMEGA returns these products with RateClassMoney.TermMile.Mileage == sentinel_mileage (effectively unlimited miles) and terms enumerated month-by-month (1, 2, 3, …) each carrying a per-month rate. A product is flagged billing_model:'monthly_subscription' when ANY of its rate rows hits the sentinel — nothing else gates it. The secondary_signals below are TELEMETRY/SANITY ONLY: the normalizer records whether the plan code is in the allowlist and whether the description contains the residual substring, and emits a mismatch event when the sentinel and the secondary signals disagree, but they NEVER gate detection.

default_quality_mapping._comment: From PlanSelectorService. Matched by partial match on plan name returned from SE GetRates.

plan_level_defaults._comment: Default presentation per PlanLevel — used when a plan has no plan_catalog entry AND no per-org override. Per v3.0.8 PDF Task 1. `tagline_default` populates the inline card subtitle; `plan_coverage_default_html` populates the 'See what's covered' modal body. v3.0.12 (2026-05-14) added `covered_components_default` — structured array used by the redesigned RecommendedCoverage tier-selector UI to render a checkmarked components grid inline. Order matches the HTML. HTML stays the source of truth for the modal; the array is the structured projection (without the 'And more!' tail row). Admin tab 'Plan presentations → Defaults' edits both.

plan_catalog._comment: Per v3.0.8 PDF Task 1 — global classification per (TpaCode, ProductTypeCode, PlanCode). Key format: `${tpa}::${ptc}::${plan_code}`. Each entry can override plan_level (else inferred via default_quality_mapping), plan_title (else falls back to PlanDescription from rater), plan_coverage_html (else falls back to plan_level_defaults[level].plan_coverage_default_html), covered_components (v3.0.12 — structured array overriding plan_level_defaults[level].covered_components_default; null defers to the tier default), sample_agreement_url (interpolated into {{SAMPLE_AGREEMENT_URL}} in coverage HTML), and docuseal_template_id (per v3.0.8 PDF Task 2 — falls back to org-level docuseal.template_id_by_plan, then docuseal.api defaults). Per-org overrides live in canon/org-registry.json::orgs[].plan_overrides and supersede this catalog. New PlanCodes returned by raters that lack a catalog entry render as Good with PlanDescription as title (per PDF default rule).
plan_catalog._seed_source: v3.0.8 PDF + user-provided Google Sheet 2026-05-11 (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-5TMtDlNPeeoD9dtrCNUK-OCZqqtCbaOoynreeiBfyw/). 14 OMGA VSC entries seeded; remaining rows + non-OMGA TPAs populate via the admin tool.
plan_catalog._basic_level_note: PlanLevel 'basic' (4 entries: OMGA 68/69/80/81) is a 4th tier below Good not yet rendered in the consumer surface. plan_level_defaults has no 'basic' block; the resolver currently normalizes unknown levels to 'good' so a Basic plan that somehow reaches the wizard falls back to Good's HTML. Future enhancement: surface Basic plans in Customize (browse-all) with their own default HTML.

Billing model is detected at runtime via the 999999 mileage sentinel (not from this catalog); these rows only carry presentation (tier/title/coverage/DocuSeal). Tiers per user 2026-06-01: 41 + R6 = good, 42 = better. _TODO: docuseal_template_id for 41/42 unknown — set in the admin Plans tab when provided (R6 = '3').
